scenarios.name: idle_ttl_touch_then_evict
scenarios.description: a load inside the idle TTL touches the session; a load past it reports expired and evicts session, identity and wrap key

scenarios.name: nonpositive_ttl_is_expired_without_eviction
scenarios.description: zero, negative and absent ttl_ns report expired but leave the cache entry in place

scenarios.name: maximum_lifetime_is_absolute
scenarios.description: activity refreshes last_access but never saved_at: an old saved_at expires a recently used session; a missing maximum falls back to eight hours

scenarios.name: probes_do_not_refresh_or_evict
scenarios.description: is_*_expired and PeekIdentity never rewrite or delete cache entries, expired or not; LoadIdentity on an expired cache evicts

scenarios.name: touch_scope_passphrase_vs_identity
scenarios.description: LoadPassphrase touches only the session record; LoadIdentity touches the identity and the shared session

scenarios.name: identity_expiry_follows_session_metadata
scenarios.description: identity expiry is judged by the shared session when present and by the identity's own metadata otherwise; a non-positive TTL expires without evicting

scenarios.name: revoke_and_clear
scenarios.description: ClearSession deletes session, identity and wrap key and is idempotent; ClearIdentity removes only the identity

scenarios.name: revoke_with_delete_failures
scenarios.description: a failing session delete aborts ClearSession before the other entries are touched; failing wrap-key or identity deletes are swallowed

scenarios.name: corrupted_session_record
scenarios.description: undecodable JSON, an invalid timestamp, a wrong field type and a zero TTL after a bad timestamp all fail as malformed without evicting

scenarios.name: incomplete_session_record
scenarios.description: a record without saved_at is expired and evicted, null time fields are Go zero time, and a record without ciphertext or nonce is expired but kept

scenarios.name: last_access_defaults_to_saved_at
scenarios.description: a missing or null last_access falls back to saved_at before the idle check

scenarios.name: tampered_and_misaddressed_ciphertext
scenarios.description: bad ciphertext, an undecodable ciphertext, or a different wrap key fail as decrypt errors and keep the entry

scenarios.name: wrap_key_states
scenarios.description: a missing, non-base64 or wrong-length wrap key fails the load; saving replaces any unusable wrap key

scenarios.name: corrupted_identity_record
scenarios.description: an undecodable identity fails as malformed everywhere, and a corrupt shared session blocks identity loads without eviction

scenarios.name: legacy_plaintext_lifecycle
scenarios.description: a live legacy plaintext session is refused until migrated; migration is a one-shot upgrade and a no-op without a session

scenarios.name: keyring_failures
scenarios.description: keyring failures surface as keyring errors, never as misses, and never delete or rewrite the cache

scenarios.name: go_sealed_vector
scenarios.description: a record sealed with a known wrap key opens, with the passphrase round trip pinned by AES-256-GCM, standard base64, a 12-byte nonce and no AAD

scenarios.name: record_shape
scenarios.description: the stored JSON field sets, the wrap-key encoding, the nonce length and the shared saved_at between session and identity are pinned

scenarios.name: fallback_miss_does_not_activate
scenarios.description: a not-found from a healthy primary is an ordinary miss and does not switch to memory

scenarios.name: fallback_activates_on_set_failure
scenarios.description: a primary Set failure is absorbed by the in-memory fallback and the session keeps working for the process

scenarios.name: fallback_activates_on_get_failure
scenarios.description: a primary Get failure activates the fallback permanently: earlier primary entries stay invisible even after the primary recovers

scenarios.name: fallback_activates_on_delete_failure
scenarios.description: a primary Delete failure is absorbed and activates the fallback

concurrency.name: concurrent_touch_and_probe_keep_live_session
concurrency.description: parallel loads, touches and non-refreshing probes never evict, corrupt or fail a live session

concurrency.name: concurrent_revoke_during_loads
concurrency.description: revoke racing loaders yields only a hit, a miss or a missing wrap key, never a panic or a torn record; a final revoke always leaves nothing

concurrency.name: concurrent_saves_recover_by_sequential_save
concurrency.description: racing first saves may leave a session sealed under a different wrap key (decrypt error); one sequential save always recovers it
